title: RecallNotice
description: The un-learning primitive. A recall withdraws one capability, flags every release whose lockfile contains it, and records the action those releases should take (quarantine, rollback or re_review); a rollback itself is a separate signed release.

reason_class.description: Why the capability is recalled. duplicate withdraws one byte-identical copy and leaves the content to the copy that stays; every other reason withdraws the content wherever it appears.

control_refs.description: Reserved for references to the actions that carried the recall out.

approval.description: Approver signatures over the exact recall, present once the workspace requires signed approvals.
